title: Market Radar
subtitle: Real sales from Rowan's Market Hall: what sells, for how much and how fast. Matched against your stock so you know what to sell right now for gold.
autoHint: While the radar is open, it checks the market again every 5 minutes (the same read the game does when you open the Market).

status.never: No market data yet. Press Refresh sales with the game open in another tab.
status.ok: Updated at {{time}} · new sales: {{added}} · open stalls: {{stalls}}
status.okNone: Updated at {{time}} · no new sales · open stalls: {{stalls}}

error.no_game_tab: I couldn't find the game open. Open Bloomshire in another tab (with the extension on) and try again.
error.signed_out: The game is open but not signed in. Sign in to Bloomshire and try again.
error.timeout: The game didn't answer. Check the extension is on and reload the game tab (F5).
error.game_error: The game returned an error reading the market. Try again in a while.

kpi.historyEmpty: builds up with each refresh (24 h)

quick.headline: If you want gold now
quick.headlineHint: Selling today at the shop what's worth it, and listing on the market what sells fast and for more.
quick.shopHint: Instant gold. The shop buys {{cap}} of each item per day.
quick.marketHint: Pays more than the shop and sells fast. Suggested price just below the cheapest stall.
quick.keepHint: Don't sell it: an active quest needs it.
quick.emptyStock: No synced stock. Connect your game with the extension to see what's worth selling.
quick.emptyShop: Nothing to sell at the shop right now.
quick.noMarketData: No market data yet: recommendations use shop prices only. Refresh sales to compare.

table.empty: No data yet. Press Refresh sales.
table.clickHint: Click an item to see its full tracking.

mine.toCollectHint: Stop by the Market Hall to collect
mine.empty: No market trades of yours yet.

detail.trendHint: last 6 h vs the previous 18 h
detail.priceHint: Each dot is a sale from the last 24 h (gold per unit). The line is the hourly median; the dashed line, the cheapest stall now.
detail.supplyHint: How supply changed at each refresh.
detail.listingsEmpty: Nobody is selling it right now.
detail.recoShop: Sell it at the shop: {{price}} each, instantly (it buys {{n}} more today).
detail.recoMarket: List it at {{price}} (you get {{net}} each after the 2.5% fee).
detail.recoKeep: Kept: an active quest needs it.
detail.recoNone: Not enough data yet to suggest a price.
detail.noData: No sales in the last 24 h.

clearConfirm: Clear the sales history saved in this browser?
footer: The game shows everyone's latest sales; the radar keeps the last 24 h in this browser. Refresh often (or open the Market in-game with the tool open) so none are missed.
